fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Varus''' kills an enemy, he gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|{{pp|10 to 20|1;7;13|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and {{sti|{{as|ability power}}}} equal to {{as|11% of his '''total bonus''' attack speed}} for {{pp|5 to 11 for 4|1 to 16}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent unit kills.
fields.description2: '''Varus''' also gains ''Living Vengeance's'' bonuses upon scoring a {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}, which empowers it for the same duration to grant him {{as|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}} as well as {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} and {{as|ability power}} equal to {{as|33% of his '''total bonus''' attack speed}}, and an increased attack speed cap of {{fd|3.33}}. ''Living Vengeance's'' empowerment may only be refreshed by subsequent champion takedowns.
fields.notes:
* '''Varus''' cannot gain the standard bonuses while ''Living Vengeance'' is empowered. If the buff was active at the time of the empowerment (from scoring a champion takedown), the duration is refreshed while overriding the standard bonuses with the empowered ones.
** If '''Varus''' kills an enemy unit (non-champion) during the empowerment, he is special cased to gain the buff again after the empowerment expires with the standard bonuses. The re-granted buff lasts for {{pp|5 to 11 for 4|1 to 16}} seconds minus the remaining duration of the empowered version at the time of the last non-champion unit he killed.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
